hero.title: Where local moments become markets.
hero.subtitle: Tap Trade turns the moments Filipinos are already watching into live prediction markets — from basketball and pageants to esports, gaming, politics, and pop culture.
steps.pick.title: Pick a moment
steps.pick.body: Elections, finals, premieres — every question on the board is a live YES/NO price, moving with each trade.
steps.hold.title: Hold to place
steps.hold.body: Press and hold to commit your points. No pop-ups, no second guesses — release early to cancel.
steps.settle.title: Watch it settle
steps.settle.body: Prices tick with every fill. When the answer lands, your points do too — and the bell tells you either way.
desks.title: Every market lives on a desk. Every desk is live.
grant.title: Your first call is on the house.
